crossRefs.note: These also are considered to be Rephaim, as the Anakim; but the Moabites call them Emim.
In the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer came, and the kings who were with him, and struck the Rephaim in Ashteroth Karnaim…

people.name: Anak
people.line: Ancestor of giant people in Canaan

people.name: Emim
people.line: An ancient people group defeated by Chedorlaomer.

translations.web: (The Emim lived there before, a great and numerous people, and tall as the Anakim.
translations.bsb: (The Emites used to live there, a people great and many, as tall as the Anakites.
translations.kjv: The Emims dwelt therein in times past, a people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims;
translations.asv: (The Emim dwelt therein aforetime, a people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakim:
